Footer.description: A Thai Buddhist temple in Germany for practice, community, and events.

WelcomeSection.description: Wat Loung Por Sai is a place for practice, learning, and quiet connection in Germany. Whether you already know temple life or are just beginning to explore, you can arrive at your own pace.
WelcomeSection.cultureDesc: Gather through sincere community and cultural activities

FirstVisitSection.title: Begin with ease before you arrive
FirstVisitSection.description: Choose an activity, prepare a few simple things, and plan your journey with confidence.
FirstVisitSection.stepOneDescription: Browse the calendar and read the details before deciding to join.
FirstVisitSection.stepTwoDescription: Dress respectfully and take part at a pace that feels right for you.
FirstVisitSection.stepThreeDescription: Check the address, route, and contact details before setting out.
FirstVisitSection.imageAlt: A temple activity and community moment

DonationSection.subtitle: Make a Donation
